title: 2005 - 1st Hong Kong Wireless Technology Excellence Awards
author: hkwtia
plainText: WTIA and Hong Kong Productivity Council (HKPC) organized the 1st Hong Kong Wireless Technology Excellence Awards to recognize the best mobile and wireless applications developed by local companies.
